effects.effect: Your devotion to your deity allows you to take command of the battlefield, letting your allies benefit from your wisdom. While you are [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to a creature, your allies gain the benefits of [flanking](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/flanking) against that creature. Additionally, your allies gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to aid other creatures with their [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test).
